pages.text: A dimension with its own tool tiers: chalkos, kassiteros, orichalcum and sideros. Vanilla torches and chests don't work properly there.

Build two facing pillar columns of equal height on a solid floor, each capped with a Pillar Head. Put a bottom-half slab on the head and another next to it, over the gap. Beside the head on its outer side, place a top-half slab.
Then throw a $(item)Greek Fire Grenade$() into the gap. This pack adds an Overworld recipe for it: string on top, blaze powder in the middle and 3 iron nuggets.
